info.name: Connectly API v1
info.description:
Comprehensive Connectly API v1 Postman collection with all 140+ endpoints organized by controller.

URL rule: every request uses `{{baseUrl}}/v1/...` where `baseUrl` must include the servlet context path `/api` (e.g. `http://localhost:8080/api` → `http://localhost:8080/api/v1/auth/login`).

Docker Compose: set `baseUrl` to `baseUrlStage` (8081), `baseUrlDemo` (8082), or `baseUrlProd` (8083), or copy that variable's value into `baseUrl` before running requests.

Mailpit verification links look like: `http://localhost:8080/api/v1/auth/verify?token=...`
